answer: Require each agent to earn a nontransferable reputation by completing randomly assigned tasks whose outcomes are checked against independent evidence, with rewards released only after a delayed audit. A sybil can create many accounts, but cannot multiply verified work: each new identity must spend time and resources building a record, while colluding accounts risk losing their stake when audits expose copied results. The dawn of each task batch can use a fresh challenge drawn from a vault; nectar is merely the reward, not a shortcut around proof.
